spans.s:
भृत्य,
 I. ptcple. fut. pass. of भृ, To be nourished.
 II. m. A servant, Pañc. 175, 16; i. d. 325.
 III. f. या, Hire.
 --Comp.

-भृ + त्, latter part of comp. nouns, Bearing, nourishing, protecting; e. g. अ-पात्र-, adj. Supporting unworthy ones, Hit. ii. d. 147. गदा-, m.
 1. A mace-bearer.
 2. A name of Kṛṣṇa, [] Bhāg.

. तनु-, m.
 1. A living creature.
 2. A man, mankind,
. तपोभृत्, i. e. तपस्-, m. An ascetic,

. देह-, m.
 1. A living creature.
 2. A man, mankind. Bhāg.

. धरणी-, m.
 1. A king.
 2. A mountain. धरा-, m. A mountain,

. धर्म-,
 1. m. Supporter of right, an epithet of kings,
. m. A proper name. नव-शशि(न्)-, Bearing the young moon, epithet of Śiva,
. प्राण-, adj. Living, a living creature, Hit. i. d. 111, M.M.; a man, mankind. भू-, see s. v.

भृत + क (see भृ),
 1. m. A servant,

भृ + ति, f.
 1. Nourishment, Hit. ii. d. 32.
 2. Wages, hire,

. Capital, principal.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. fors; A.S. beordh.
भृत्य + ता, f., and भृत्यत्व भृत्य + त्व, n. Servitude, service, dependence, Pañc. 24, 11; Hit. ii. d. 37.
+ वर्ग भृत्य- + वर्ग m. servants, ib. (cf. my transl. and Böhtl. Ind.
